pipeline_graph.derivation: aiops-intake.json + redaction-report.json -> semantic-chunk-plan.json -> pr-brief.json + chunk-payload-manifest.json + chunk-payloads/<id>.json -> [consumer: Router] -> chunk-responses/<id>.json -> chunk-results.json -> final-review.{json,md} -> review-quality-gate.json -> review-telemetry.json
pipeline_graph.consumption_note: parse-chunks consumes semantic-chunk-plan.json + chunk-responses/ only; synthesize consumes chunk-results.json (+ optional plan/intake/redaction); quality-gate consumes final-review.json + chunk-results.json (+ optional intake/plan/redaction/checks, --critical-pr). pr-brief.json and chunk-payload-manifest.json are NOT consumed downstream of build-payloads.
pipeline_graph.authority: review-quality-gate.json is the only v1 decision artifact consumed by the publisher; final-review.md is the published text

obligations.proposition: Every file lacking an observable textual hunk is excluded from files_covered at plan level, for all tiers, with a tier-distinct reason code.
positive_controls: same PR where the non-must file has a textual hunk remains complete/passed
obligations.discriminator: paired input differing only in presence of the @@ hunk for the non-must file
obligations.closure_predicate: RED on base, GREEN on head, observed at the gate output; mutation of the generalized predicate back to must_review-only turns the focal test RED
obligations.open_decision: whether a non-must hunk-less file degrades the plan (status) or only moves to files_not_covered with an informational code — to be fixed in the V1-C1 task contract against #232's own text ('coverage: complete' semantics)

obligations.proposition: Tests whose subject is not hunk availability supply synthetic hunks; tests that pin the CM-C1-01 outcome as expected are reconciled, not preserved by construction.
obligations.closure_predicate: no committed test asserts complete/passed for an input containing a hunk-less file without also asserting that file's non-covered state

obligations.proposition: A claim can only qualify for claim coverage if it comes from a structured, target-owned, admitted artifact with a stable id; free-text PR claims are at most advisory context.
obligations.mechanism_site: NONE on subject (must_hold is list[str], no id, dropped first under budget)
obligations.closure_predicate: decided in V1-C2 owner reconciliation; if closure needs a new structured claim object + response contract extension + downstream consumption, STOP_OWNER_BOUNDARY and document the minimum compatible alternative

obligations.proposition: A non-empty contracts/review-packs document that v1 cannot flatten yields a limitation distinct from contracts_context_not_relevant.
positive_controls: list-shaped rules with a path-matching rule still inject contract context
obligations.closure_predicate: unparseable-shape input produces the distinct code; list-shaped input unchanged; golden payload fixtures unchanged for list-shaped input

obligations.proposition: A finding lacking a checkable negative consequence or whose cited subject is not present in the reviewed material is downgraded to observation with a reason code, at all severities.
obligations.mechanism_site: app/agent_review/finding_normalizer.py:122-227 (reuse _downgrade_or_reject); aboutness needs reviewed material as new parser input
positive_controls: PC-C3-01: real contract violation with concrete hunk evidence and demonstrated consequence survives at its severity
obligations.closure_predicate: each CM RED->GREEN at the gate; PC-C3-01 GREEN before and after; mutation removing each predicate turns its focal test RED
constraints: response-contract change requires positive justification against frozen v1 golden fixtures

obligations.proposition: Every limitation code emitted by v1 is classified informational vs obligation-degrading, and every obligation-degrading code reaches the gate through a consumed artifact.
obligations.mechanism_site: plan-level restatement (semantic_chunker) or explicit gate input; manifest/brief are not consumed today
obligations.closure_predicate: classification table committed; one test per degrading class at gate level
obligations.owner: distributed (#232 for hunk, #221/#805 for contracts, #307 for result coverage)

obligations.proposition: A P0/P1 whose file the same result declared not reviewed (or not in any reviewed bucket) is an untrusted blocker candidate, not a trusted blocking conclusion.
positive_controls: P1 on a reviewed file stays passed/changes_requested
obligations.closure_predicate: REPRODUCED RED -> GREEN; mechanism removed -> focal RED; restored -> GREEN; positive control unchanged

obligations.proposition: A result in which the reviewed-file set does not cover the plan's expected files cannot produce a conclusive approving gate outcome, independent of critical_pr.
positive_controls: all files reviewed, no findings -> passed/approved unchanged
obligations.closure_predicate: the no-plan/all-not-reviewed assertion discriminates the coverage mechanism itself (not a side channel such as final_review mutation); committed golden, not an incidental base-vs-head comparison

obligations.proposition: Remaining trust edges are exercised by a bounded mutation campaign as #307 prescribes.
obligations.closure_predicate: every edge in the declared set killed or documented as equivalent with reasoning

obligations.proposition: #315 has exactly one recorded disposition among A (stronger v1-compatible closure), B (explicit residual-risk acceptance + documented limitation), C (disable/replace lane).
obligations.closure_predicate: decision contract committed; B or C requires explicit human decision (#221: no waivers granted by the epic) -> STOP_UNRESOLVED_POLICY until recorded

obligations.proposition: No repository document states protection stronger than regex/blocklist redaction for v1.
obligations.closure_predicate: grep of v1 docs for strict/structural sanitization claims returns only the weakened form

obligations.proposition: Engine output published by the consumer equals the CT104 result, no semantic recomputation at publish time.
obligations.closure_predicate: final canary after repin binds repo/PR/base/head/toolrepo/run/coverage/bundle digest (outside this traversal's grant)
